title: Chapter 929
text:
Flickering World, Purple River Star System.

This was one of the seven territories of the Black Star Corps. It was located at the edge of the Garu Star Cluster and was one of the important gateways to enter the Star Cluster. At this time, a huge Black Star Corps fleet slowly sailed out of the stargate of the Purple River Star System. This was the construction team led by Herlous himself.

Beside this stargate station, a large number of Black Star Corps spaceships were waiting for Herlous' arrival. The two teams merged. This was the first exploration fleet. After the exploration was completed, tens of millions of exploration fleets gathered in the seven territories to serve as construction workers and wait for orders from the upper echelons.

In the conference room of the main ship, Herlous was having a meeting with the remote projections of Sylvia, Lagi, and the other senior officers to discuss the construction plan.

"Purple River, Long Day, Ponzale, Orlando, Fenrir, Sigma, and Edney, these seven Star Systems belong to the Black Star Corps. We will first complete the infrastructure construction, then carefully carve and slowly transform the Star System," Herlous said with a serious expression.

Although he liked to slack off, he was still very serious about the missions given to him by Han Xiao.

Sylvia nodded. "First, build the stargate transportation network of the seven Star Systems and link them together to make it convenient for fleets to travel. During the exploration period, the transportation network has already taken shape. Hmm, this will be very convenient. Next, we will install the army's own security devices and space monitoring devices, as well as large-scale quantum network base stations, making the seven Star Systems the territory of the army's artificial intelligence. "

When the Black Star Army took over the seven Star Systems, they would need to build their own infrastructure and forge them into an iron plate.

"According to the blueprints left by the Army Commander, we need to focus on the two gateway Star Systems, Purple River and Ponzale. We need to firmly control the stargates of the main transportation routes. These stargates were originally guarded by the dynasty's army, but they are now under our control. We need to leave some guards behind."

"… In terms of planet transformation, we will focus on the army's base and the resource excavation base first. Those galactic cities and transit stations will only be put to use after the Star Field opens up. The construction can be delayed."

"The Army Commander's blueprint says that the Sigma Star System at the center of the Star Cluster will be the logistical headquarters of the army in the Flickering World. That place also needs to be heavily modified to build a large number of barracks, military factories, and spaceports …"

The seven Star Systems covered a large area, and the construction work was very arduous. Han Xiao had given them the blueprint, and the specific operation plan needed to be formulated by Herlous, Sylvia, and the other people in charge.

While everyone was discussing, Lagi carried out his usual style of not caring about anything at all and acted as a mascot.

Soon, they came up with a plan. Under Herlous' command, the construction team started to work in an orderly manner. They built the stargate channel and set up various devices. The facilities left behind during the exploration period could be used again, saving a lot of resources.

At the same time, Bloodshed Land, Klent, and the other dynasty allies also started to build their own territories. The entire Flickering World entered a state of construction.

Developing a new Star Field was a long-term project, and it would take many years to transform it into the prosperous appearance of the explored universe. The seven Star Systems were all rich areas and important areas in his previous life. Han Xiao estimated that it would take decades to complete the blueprint according to his memory. The next phase of the Red Empire's exploration plan would not be so long apart. The second phase of the exploration would probably begin when the first two Star Systems were completed.

While the construction team was in full swing, the mechanical life and the Black Spirit Race also arrived at the new home planet that Han Xiao had designated.

…

The Sigma Star System was the central area of the Garu Star Cluster. It was rich in resources and connected to the other two territories, Edney and Orlando.

Planet Apostle was a resource planet in this Star System named by Han Xiao. It was gray in color and had rich mineral veins and metal resources. Although it was not a habitable planet in the conventional sense, it was suitable for mechanical life to live in.

Dozens of spaceships slowly landed on a gray wasteland. Psionic Prime led the hundred thousand mechanical lives out of the spaceship and looked around. The wasteland extended to the end of the horizon. There was no greenery in sight, only endless gray rocks and flying sand.

"This will be our home from now on."

Psionic Prime tapped his spear and ordered everyone to build the city immediately.

If it were a normal creature, they would most likely feel the hardships of building a civilization from scratch on such a desolate planet. However, such emotions did not exist for mechanical life. Their mentality was more similar to that of the colonists.

With the construction equipment provided by the Black Star Corps and their own talents, the mechanical life built the city very quickly.

Looking down from the sky, a metal region appeared on the surface and gradually spread out. A mechanical city rose from the ground.

The first thing that was built was a large number of weapon factories. With sufficient raw materials, mechanical life forms were assembled one after another. A portion of the mechanical life forms consumed their own life energy to synthesize their own tinder genetic code and hatch the second generation of mechanical life forms.

Mass production was the strength of the mechanical life forms.

At the same time, the mechanical life forms detected the distribution of the underground mines and used their construction equipment to build excavation wells. They dug out rocks and sent materials into the warehouse continuously.

Without enemies, the construction efficiency of the mechanical life forms was terrifyingly high. Under the actions of Psionic Prime and the other mechanical life forms, Planet Apostle was rapidly transforming.

On the other side, the Black Spirit Race had also arrived at their new home — the new Planet Black Spirit in the Edney Star System.

This planet was different from the desolate Planet Apostle. It was a habitable planet with vast vegetation and lush forests. There were also many gentle native beasts.

The migration fleet landed on a fertile plain. The Black Spirit Race swarmed out of their spaceships and looked around curiously with their evolved green eyes.

"Is this our new home?"

"It seems even more beautiful."

A spaceship shot out a tractor beam and placed the statue of Black Star on the plain. They could not move the Black Spirit Race's city, but they could still move a landmark.

To the Black Spirit Race, the statue of Black Star was a landmark. It was similar to a 'cultural wonder'. They could abandon the city, but they could not abandon the statue.

Han Xiao needed the Black Spirit Race to develop in the next few decades, so he could only interfere with the progress of the Black Spirit Race's civilization. These spaceships that transported the Black Spirit Race had many pieces of equipment and would not leave. Instead, they would stay behind to help the Black Spirit Race build their home.

Under the gaze of the Black Spirit Race, an army member handed a communicator to the Germinal Tribe leader.

"This contains the knowledge that God Black Star has given you. You can learn it and use it to transform your race."

The Germinal Tribe leader carefully opened the communicator, and a list popped up on the screen. It was all technological information. This was a technology tree that Han Xiao had tailored according to the racial characteristics of the Black Spirit Race. It had everything from basic to high-end subjects.

An entire system of technology tree could ensure that the Black Spirit Race's development would not go astray.

With the efficient communication through the mental network, all the Black Spirit Race members quickly learned about this matter and worshipped the statue of Black Star.

"Thank you, God Black Star, for your gift!"

The Germinal Tribe leader was extremely excited. This emotion spread to all his people, and their faith became even more fervent.

The sacred knowledge that God Black Star had given to them was of historical significance to the entire race. This scene would forever be engraved in the inherited memories of the Black Spirit Race.

Although mechanical life and the Black Spirit Race existed in different forms, they had some similar characteristics. For example, both of them had the ability to think like a hive. One was a mental network, while the other was a quantum network. They could highly condense the productivity of the race. Races with this characteristic all had unparalleled development potential.

To a certain extent, the Black Spirit Race was similar to the Zerg Race. As long as they were on the right track, they would be able to enter the fast lane of civilization development. The mechanical life was even more impressive. They had extremely high technological standards from the start and only lacked land and population.

Han Xiao had high hopes for both of them. He had purposely placed them in different Star Systems in hopes of giving them sufficient space to develop.

Speaking of which, when both of them developed, they could be treated as natural disasters. If the fourth natural disaster, which was the players …

Of the four natural disasters, he occupied three of them!

…

In the past month, countless people had been paying attention to the construction of the Flickering World by the Red Empire and its allies. This was the most eye-catching event in the entire universe. Other than that, all other news was overshadowed.

Like the other allies, the Black Star Corps had also placed their focus on the Flickering World. They had invested a lot of manpower and resources, and they were in full swing.

Taking advantage of the time when the Black Star Corps was occupied by the Flickering World, the Limitless Financial Group had finally made a move on the interests of the Black Star Corps in the Shattered Star Ring.
